Subject: Re: Questions on Companion observability pack pricing/credits

Hi Jill — really appreciate the detailed ingest profile. Quick answers up front, then a proposed commercial path.

Retention credits mapping:
- Hot tier (0-30 days): consumes credits at 1x per GB-day.
- Warm tier (31-90 days): 0.25x per GB-day (automatic tiering available).
- Archive (>90 days): 0.05x per GB-day.
We can pre-stage warm-tier credits if you want cheaper ongoing retention with slightly higher retrieval latency.

Tracing credits:
- We meter by sampled span-ingest and span-size. For heavy-span services we recommend an initial sample rate of 10% with adaptive sampling enabled.
- Bursts are smoothed using a 7-day rolling window; if you exceed commit we apply overage at the negotiated per-million-span rate or draw from upfront tracing credits.

Advanced dashboards SKU:
- Two options: seat-linked (per power user) or project-linked (flat project SKU for unlimited viewers). Given your note (7 users, 2–3 power users) the seat model usually wins if you want strictly lower cost for small power team.

Proposed concession & pilot path (commercial):
- 12-month commit. In exchange: 25k retention credits (applies across tiers), 5M tracing credits preloaded, and first 3 months of "advanced dashboards" included at no-charge for up to 4 power users.
- Pricing discount: 18% off list for the observability add-on if signed within 30 days.
- Overages: First 10% over commit each month auto-drawn from a pooled grace buffer; additional overage billed at standard rate.

I'll attach a short PDF pricing summary and a draft SOW for your procurement team. If this looks directionally right we can get Ben to finalize discount authority and produce a commercial redline.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Attachment: companion_pack_pricing_v1.pdf (pdf, 18KB)

Marcus — thanks for the draft. A couple of pricing guardrails and an alternative concession we can offer that is easier to approve: 

- Discount authority: I can approve up to 18% as proposed for a 12m commit. Above 18% will need SDR/VP sign-off.
- Alternative concession (less headroom impact): instead of 25k retention credits up front, we can offer 12k retention credits + a 6-week pilot with full dashboards enabled and a 2-week grace buffer for tracing overages. This preserves margin while giving Brightlane runway to validate value.
- Seat mapping: we should propose a hybrid SKU: 2 power-user seats included, additional seats at a discounted rate (first 3 add-on seats at 50% list for the first 6 months). That addresses their 7-user observation but keeps us protected.
- Billing/proration: recommend monthly invoice with prorated credits drawdown; for SOW put an explicit clause that overage smoothing uses the 7-day rolling window and that Brightlane can request a one-time sample-rate adjustment during the pilot without penalty.

Marcus — if that sounds ok I can send the counterproposal language and updated SOW draft.

Ben Carter
Director, Commercial — Redwood Inference
